task: Write a Python function that takes an S3 bucket name and a prefix string as arguments and returns a list of all object keys in that bucket matching the prefix, handling pagination automatically using boto3.
solution_criteria: Uses boto3 S3 client or resource, handles pagination via paginator or NextContinuationToken, filters by prefix, returns a flat list of object key strings, includes basic error handling

task: Write an IAM policy JSON document that allows a user to list all S3 buckets in the account and read (get/download) objects only from a bucket named 'my-readonly-bucket', but explicitly denies the ability to delete any S3 objects across all buckets.
solution_criteria: Valid IAM policy JSON with Version and Statement fields, includes separate statements for ListAllMyBuckets, GetObject scoped to the specific bucket ARN, and an explicit Deny for s3:DeleteObject on all resources using Effect Allow/Deny correctly

task: Write a regular expression that validates an Amazon Resource Name (ARN) and captures its components (partition, service, region, account-id, and resource) as named capture groups. A valid ARN follows the format: arn:partition:service:region:account-id:resource.
solution_criteria: Matches the arn: prefix, uses named capture groups for all five components, correctly handles ARNs where region or account-id may be empty (e.g. IAM ARNs), does not produce false positives on clearly invalid strings
